Northgate Bank (ChaseZero): Discover and shape pack

Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) Pack, November 2026. Built from corporate KYC discovery, desk telemetry, and stakeholder interviews.

1 Problem2 Found3 Solution tree4 ICE ranking5 People6 First slice7 Architecture8 Unknowns

1. Problem statement

Corporate Relationship Managers (RMs) and KYC Analysts need to stop chasing clients with manual emails and re-requesting already-submitted documents, because corporate facility onboarding takes 62 days (17 days lost purely to document chasing across 3+ rounds) and 68% of chases go unanswered beyond the 3-day SLA. We will know it worked when average days per chase round falls from 5.5 days to a target of 3.0 days, reducing total corporate onboarding toward 30 days.

In short: leadership asked for autonomous AI to speed up corporate KYC onboarding. We found the bottleneck is manual document tracking and ungrounded follow-up emails. So we use rules to lock verified documents and flag >3d SLA breaches, GenAI only to draft grounded follow-ups, a Critic gate to check 5 compliance rules, and the Relationship Manager to sign off every email. Everything stays inside Northgate’s secure cloud tenancy.

6. First slice (four to six weeks)

Who and which cases

  • Corporate RMs, KYC Analysts, Compliance Ops
  • 3 Desks: FX & Rates, Energy & Commodities, Structured Debt (400 pilot accounts)
  • High-value corporate facilities (£29.5M to £85M)

What we build

  • S1 & S7: SQLite SLA Watchdog (>3d) & locked Verified document checklist
  • S4 & S6: 3-Node LangGraph (Orchestrator → Drafter → Critic 5-rule QA with retry circuit breaker)
  • S10 & S11: RM HMAC-SHA256 sign-off + Tamper-evident SEC/FinCEN audit ledger

What we leave out

  • Unreviewed auto-send to clients (S12)
  • Automated credit underwriting or facility limit changes
  • External live registry scraping (S9)
  • Retail consumer banking KYC
WhenWhat happens
Week 1Baseline chase round timestamps across FX & Rates, Energy, and Structured Debt desks. Lock the 5 Critic QA guardrails and PII redaction rules with David Chen (Compliance).
Weeks 2 and 3Deploy SQLite WAL SLA Watchdog, LangGraph Drafter + Critic QA loop (max 3 retries), and OpenTelemetry GenAI per-step USD cost attribution inside Cloud Run tenancy.
Weeks 4 and 5Pilot live with Sarah Jenkins (RM) and Marcus Vance (Analyst) across active corporate cases. Measure chase round velocity, Critic intercept rate, and RM review seconds.
Week 6Executive review with Eleanor Sterling (COO). Verify SHA-256 ledger integrity, confirm chase cycle drop (5.5d → 3.1d), and prepare APAC desk expansion blueprint.

Success measures: days per chase round (5.5d → 3.1d), unresponsive rate (68% → 9%), RM review time (~48s), AI cost per chase (~$0.015), and 100% Critic grounding accuracy.

7. Architecture

AI prepares and compliance-checks the draft; a Relationship Manager signs and dispatches every communication. All data, traces, and audit logs remain inside Northgate’s cloud tenancy.

StepToolWho decidesReusesDoor

3 Draft grounded follow-up emailLangGraph AI Drafter (Gemini 2.5)Model drafts text only (status stays Missing/Draft)Missing doc list & RM notesTwo-way (model swappable; zero external send)
4 Audit draft against 5 compliance rulesCritic Compliance QA Gate + RulesSystem blocks if <95% or unauthorized promise; loops up to 3xPRA/FCA & SEC/FinCEN policy rulesTwo-way
5 Review, adjust tone & authorizeHuman-in-the-Loop Review GatewayRelationship Manager (Sarah Jenkins) signs with HMAC-SHA256Authenticated RM sessionOne-way once dispatched to client
6 Redact PII & chain audit recordPIIRedactor + SEC/FinCEN Merkle LedgerDeterministic rules + DB triggers block UPDATE/DELETESQLite WAL + OTel traceparentTwo-way

Why GenAI only drafts

Writing tailored executive emails across complex multi-document corporate structures is where GenAI excels. Document status checks stay deterministic in SQLite, and final client transmission stays strictly with the Relationship Manager.

One-way doors we keep shut

  • AI emailing clients without RM sign-off
  • Promising credit approval or regulatory waivers
  • Re-requesting already-Verified documents
  • Storing unredacted UBO PII in telemetry logs

Safety gates

  • 5-check Critic QA before Draft_Ready
  • Retry circuit breaker (halts at 3 rejections)
  • Cryptographic RM HMAC-SHA256 signature
  • Immutable SHA-256 ledger (DB triggers block edits)
